custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an inactive part for this test, part A, and an active part for this test, part B.
  • Have a canned job, canned job 1, that holds part A and part B.
  • Create an open work order for this test, work order 1, with one line.
  • Make sure the app is in the Light theme.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1600 pixels wide with the page zoom at 100%, so the screen is as wide as the design boards.
  • Open the attached design pictures of boards 6.4 and 6.5 at 100% zoom, so you can compare the screen with them.
  • Start on the Work Orders page.

Setup

  1. Make part A: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill in: Description: ZZAUTOTEST PL C839491 PART A; Part Number: ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839491-A; Category: any one; Cost: 10.00; Sell Price: 20.00; Quantity (in the bin row): 5. Click Save.
  2. Make part B: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill in: Description: ZZAUTOTEST PL C839491 PART B; Part Number: ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839491-B; Category: any one; Cost: 10.00; Sell Price: 20.00; Quantity (in the bin row): 5. Click Save.
  3. Make a work order to build the canned job on: Click Work Orders in the top bar, then Create Work Order. Pick any Customer and any Asset. Click Save. In the New Line window that opens, type ZZAUTOTEST PL C839491 LINE C in Title and press Tab, pick any Labor Rate, tick Line Approved, then click Save & Close.
  4. Put the parts on that line: Add parts A and B, one of each: in the line's Parts row click + Add Part, type the part number in Part number, pick the result that shows Inventory Qty, type 1 in Qty * and click Save.
  5. Save the line as canned job A: Click the three-dot icon on the line, then Save as canned line. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C839491 CANNED JOB A in Line Title. Click Save As Canned Line. Then set part A inactive:
  6. Set part A inactive: On the Inventory page click Search and type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839491-A. Click its row, click Inactive under Part Status, click Save, then click Deactivate.
  7. Make work order 1: Click Work Orders in the top bar, then Create Work Order. Pick any Customer and any Asset. Click Save. In the New Line window that opens, type ZZAUTOTEST PL C839491 LINE 1 in Title and press Tab, pick any Labor Rate, then click Save & Close.
